aiReadyLines.text: 116 ENGLISH FOR TODAY
Patriotism is the love and devotion for one’s country. It inspires individuals to work for
the betterment of their nation and uphold its values. A true patriot respects the country’s
history, culture, and traditions while striving to contribute to its progress. Patriotism is
not just about celebrating national holidays or waving flags; it is about taking responsi-
bility for the nation’s welfare. Patriots are willing to make sacrifices for their country,
whether by serving in the military, participating in community service, or simply being
responsible citizens. Patriotism fosters unity and strengthens the bond among people,
regardless of their differences. It encourages us to protect our country’s sovereignty
and work towards peace and prosperity. In times of crisis, patriots stand together to
overcome challenges. True patriotism is selfless and rooted in a genuine desire to see
the nation thrive. It is a virtue that every citizen should cherish and practice.
